durability: Exact first source copies and raw outputs are retained in this audit directory.
execution-source-pins.json, qualification.json and review.json are authenticated against the final admission commit before any future permit.
falsification: qualification.json retains component-specific rejecting controls; oracle.py independently reconstructs complete original lifetime and command records.
bounds controls reject smaller ceilings; source controls reject altered committed inputs; first inode/mode and inventory failures remain exact.
missing_leg: Actual worker execution, contention, cancellation and native cleanup remain unexecuted; prospective model sizes are not runtime measurements.
re_derivation: audit.py --verify-saved reconstructs fixed current models, selected source inventory and conservative maximum-width shapes.
review_claims.py independently compares published claim identities and Git-derived book metrics.
scope: Source-only model and bound qualification; no native worker acquisition, fixture allocation or execution authority.
